lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Vegeta, I don't understand. Why would you let Babidi do this?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You don't get it. How could you?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You, who's never once questioned why he fights.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You've always lived for yourself, trained for yourself.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: But once you were gone, I lost what drove me to be better.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And now, I'm going to PTA meetings and Krillin's movie nights!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Listen to me, Kakarot! I'm using his fucking name!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: But now I have a chance.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: A chance to finally fight you one-on-one.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Just you, me, and my victory.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, look, Geets, I'm just here for the fight.
